adaptive_meta_plan.expected_effect: On the next matched archive, slot0 should emit a mutate decision on the first parent with rule 5 rather than a crossover, and slot1 should emit a crossover of the first two parents with rule 0 rather than a single-parent mutate. The round-4 meta decision should emit revise with rotated evidence rather than repair with the old ordering. This should test whether preserving the best low-replication gpu0/rule-5 behavior while varying search operator and evidence emphasis improves the generator's selected decisions without changing evaluator or budgets.
adaptive_meta_plan.falsification: If the new entry points still return the parent task/meta decisions on the exact matched archive, or if slot0 does not switch to mutate/rule5 and slot1 does not switch to crossover/rule0, the revision fails the decision-change gate. adaptive_meta_plan.mechanism_change: Swap the task operators: even slots now mutate the top archived parent with rule 5; odd slots now crossover the top two parents with rule 0. Preserve the gpu0-owner, low-replication, rule-5-reclaim pattern and cite child/00 plus parent/01 as negative controls. In meta, rotate evidence to [e1,e3,e0,e2] and choose mode by round: rethink on multiples of 3, revise on even rounds, repair on odd rounds, so round 4 changes from repair to revise. This is a real decision change, not guidance-only.
adaptive_meta_plan.observed_problem: Selected training evidence shows r0003/child/01 feasible at 114.034891, child/00 at 114.880932, parent/00 at 114.053286, and parent/01 at 115.029822. That repetition does not encode the training ordering or self-revise when the better child/01 and parent/00 pattern is already available.
